entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: The blue-aligned praetor of New Phyrexia whose twisted sciences made planeswalker compleation possible; presumed dead, devoured by his newts.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who challenged Jin-Gitaxias to compleat planeswalkers and is destroyed by Karn.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who aided Jin-Gitaxias, was captured by him, and later escaped after Jin-Gitaxias bound him.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Ruler of Mirrodin deemed incompetent by Jin-Gitaxias; destroys Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Praetor hated by Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Praetor whose views of perfection differ from Jin-Gitaxias's.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Praetor whose prophetic visions gave Jin-Gitaxias creature designs.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought Jin-Gitaxias on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought Jin-Gitaxias and was compleated into the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: Figure who cut Jin-Gitaxias in half on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Mirran rebel Jin-Gitaxias was about to strike down.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Now an archangel, intervenes to save Koth.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: Healer whose abilities are weakened by Jin-Gitaxias's oil.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Leader whose intentions Jin-Gitaxias had known; his scrapchiefs rebelled.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: Faction Jin-Gitaxias worked with on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Futurist who worked with Jin-Gitaxias in the Towashi Undercity.

entities.name: Chrome Host of Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Jin-Gitaxias's army that invaded many planes.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The soulless machine-people ruled by the praetors.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian world, phased out of existence after the final battle.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where Jin-Gitaxias experimented on kami.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: World of five suns infected by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Invasion Tree that the rebels gain control of.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane whose reemergence phases out New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of the multiverse in which Jin-Gitaxias was presumed killed.

entities.name: Great Synthesis
entities.description: Jin-Gitaxias's revisionist philosophy of perfecting Phyrexia.

events.summary: Elesh Norn challenges Jin-Gitaxias to find a way to turn planeswalkers into Phyrexians; with Tezzeret he goes to Kamigawa.
events.quote: the praetor Elesh Norn challenged Jin-Gitaxias to find a way to turn planeswalkers into Phyrexians.

events.summary: On Kamigawa Jin-Gitaxias experiments on kami and devises a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul.
events.quote: he successfully devised a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul.

events.summary: Kaito Shizuki and Tamiyo discover his base and fight him; the Wanderer cuts him in half.
events.quote: the Wanderer appeared suddenly and cut him in half.

events.summary: Tezzeret recovers Jin-Gitaxias's body and rebuilds him on New Phyrexia, where he compleats Tamiyo into the first Phyrexian planeswalker.
events.quote: where he compleated the kidnapped Tamiyo into the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias makes the glistening oil more virulent and potent, speeding compleation.
events.quote: He also made it much more potent

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias builds Tezzeret a darksteel body then binds him, revealing he knew of Tezzeret's and Urabrask's intentions; a scrapchief attacks him and Tezzeret escapes.
events.quote: The praetor slew the scrapchief, but Tezzeret escaped before he could be further experimented upon.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias is present in the Seedcore as Norn captures Mirran rebels and is ready to kill Koth before Elspeth intervenes.
events.quote: was prepared to strike down Koth before Elspeth , now an archangel, intervened.

events.summary: When Jin-Gitaxias advises Norn otherwise, she tears off his arm; he retreats and prepares his war machine with a vat of newts.
In the final battle Jin-Gitaxias orders his army to kill Norn, but Zhalfirin forces collapse his war machine and his newts devour him.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias fell into his vat of newts, who promptly devoured him.

events.summary: Norn destroys the Gitaxian army but is gravely wounded and destroyed by Karn; New Phyrexia phases out of existence.
events.quote: she was finally overtaken and destroyed by Karn.

relations.quote: He hated Vorinclex and considered Karn too incompetent to rule.
each directed by intelligence from Jin-Gitaxias himself.

relations.note: Destroyed her in her weakened state.
relations.quote: she was finally overtaken and destroyed by Karn.

relations.note: Tezzeret aided him on Kamigawa before Jin-Gitaxias betrayed him.
relations.quote: With the aid of Tezzeret , Jin-Gitaxias arrived on Kamigawa
